## AI Code 2

```{r}
create_df <- function(x, y) {
  df <- data.frame(
    input1 = x,
    input2 = y
  )
  
  return(list(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    df = df
  ))
}
```

```{r}
grid <- expand.grid(
  x = 1:2,
  y = 4:5
)

results <- mapply(
  create_df,
  grid$x,
  grid$y,
  SIMPLIFY = FALSE
)

results
```

```{r}
a_vals <- c(2, 5)
b_vals <- c(3, 7)

grid <- expand.grid(
  i = seq_along(results),
  a = a_vals,
  b = b_vals
)

grid
```

```{r}
final_output <- mapply(function(i, a, b) {
  res <- results[[i]]
  
  data.frame(
    x = res$x,
    y = res$y,
    a = a,
    b = b,
    value = res$x * a + res$y * b
  )
}, grid$i, grid$a, grid$b, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

final_df <- do.call(rbind, final_output)

final_df
```
